set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_HEAD=10ec84336f941df19ff0d3df6ce220c31c7f143e; EXPECTED_FIRMWARE=a5726b89e94b9ac628249b780d6548a692c3fd2c; PREV_LAST_UPTIME=24071699; git fetch --quiet origin mvp/environment-controller; REMOTE_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller); echo EXPECTED_HEAD=$EXPECTED_HEAD; echo REMOTE_SHA=$REMOTE_SHA; test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; git reset --hard "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; PORT=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())'); echo PORT=$PORT; OUT=/tmp/stage27c-final-long-soak-chunk05-20260903-v1; rm -rf "$OUT"; .venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 5400 --progress-seconds 300 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_FIRMWARE" --max-scd-age-ms 10000 --max-tp-age-ms 60000 --max-xiaomi-age-ms 30000 --require-sd --strict; echo STAGE27C_FINAL_LONG_SOAK_CHUNK05_SUMMARY; cat "$OUT/summary.json"; .venv/bin/python - "$OUT/summary.json" "$PREV_LAST_UPTIME" "$EXPECTED_FIRMWARE" <<'PY'
import json, sys
s=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
prev=int(sys.argv[2]); expected=sys.argv[3]
assert s.get('passed') is True, s
assert s.get('firmware_sha') == expected, s.get('firmware_sha')
assert int(s.get('first_uptime_ms', 0)) > prev, (s.get('first_uptime_ms'), prev)
print('STAGE27C_FINAL_LONG_SOAK_CHUNK05_OK', {'first_uptime_ms':s.get('first_uptime_ms'),'last_uptime_ms':s.get('last_uptime_ms'),'records':s.get('records'),'last_sd_records_written':s.get('last_sd_records_written'),'min_heap_internal':s.get('min_heap_internal'),'min_heap_internal_largest':s.get('min_heap_internal_largest'),'min_heap_psram':s.get('min_heap_psram'),'min_stack_free':s.get('min_stack_free')})
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
